title: Columbia top 80 — field and subfield classification
description: One row per unchanged T1 author ID, with original name, rank and counts. Distinct author-affiliated 2021–2024 snapshot works vote via validated OpenAlex primary topic. Plurality field across classified works, then plurality subfield within selected field; numeric taxonomy ID ascending resolves ties. Coverage is per eligible work; field share is per classified work; subfield share is per assigned-field work. Top tie count is number of categories sharing the maximum; close non-tie is a positive lead of at most five percentage points over an actual runner-up. Unclassified uses null IDs and explicit labels. Use T2 unchanged.
